task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First, it would be great if you could ensure that the passageway is open. After opening the passageway, make an effort to move east. Okay, and then, pick up the legume from the shelf. And once you've done that, you win!
description:
Look around you. Take it all in. It's not every day someone gets to be in a kitchen. You can barely contain your excitement.

Look over there! a refrigerator. Make a note of this, you might have to put stuff on or in it later on. The refrigerator contains a passkey. Look out! It's a- oh, never mind, it's just a plate. The plate is typical. But the thing is empty. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the plate.

There is a closed passageway leading east. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unblocked.
